title: PandaDoc pricing explained (October 2026): what a small team actually pays
description:
PandaDoc publishes two plans for small teams: Starter at $19 per seat per month (up to 5 templates) and Business at $49 per seat per month (unlimited templates). For a team of 10 that is $2,280 a year on Starter or $5,880 a year on Business.

What the plans cost a 10-person team, the template limit that pushes teams up a tier, what a small team actually uses PandaDoc for, and when to buy it or build your own quote builder from a free spec (Claude built one from the spec and all 29 acceptance checks passed).

Sam's on-camera intro and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.

PandaDoc pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/pandadoc
The Quote Builder spec (free): https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/quote-builder
SaaS pricing for small teams (36 tools): https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/guides/saas-pricing-for-small-teams
All blueprints on GitHub: https://github.com/samclaassen/internal-tool-blueprints

Prices: PandaDoc Starter $19 and Business $49 per seat per month (pandadoc.com/pricing, October 2026). Proposify Grow, which adds discount-based approvals, is $325 per month for 5 seats (proposify.com/pricing, October 2026). Yearly figures are the published per-seat price x 12 months. Prices change; check the vendor's page before you buy.
